card.name: Words inside female-subject sentences
card.fires_on: Words in the middle of a sentence about women or female animals, just before the text states what happens to her. Often a verb or linking word such as 'with', 'in', 'decreased' or 'marrying'.

modes.label: Female patients and effects
modes.description: Words after 'In female patients' leading into sexual side effects of SSRIs or SNRIs.
modes.example: In female patients, SNRI use may result<< in>> decreased libido and delayed or absent orgasm.

modes.label: Women or female animals acting
modes.description: Verbs or adverbs in sentences about a woman or female cat and her partners.

modes.label: Couples and relationships
modes.description: Words about dating or marrying, where the subject is a woman.

card.writes: It pushes toward male-word predictions such as brother, guy and father-son, and away from female words, so it seems to mark a male counterpart coming next.
card.plain: It fires in sentences about women or female animals, when a male partner or male contrast may come next.
